svg.text: KV Cache Management Layer for Scalable LLM Inference - github.com/LMCache/LMCache - arXiv 2510.09665
L1 - Inference Engines + Workloads (vendor-neutral KV layer - engine-independent daemon)
L2 - Deployment Modes + Engine Integration (modular KV connector decoupled from engine evolution)
LMCACHE_CONFIG_FILE or env vars - quick single-node
No fate-sharing - cache survives engine crash
Layer-wise + bulky KV offload hooks in runner
L3 - Dual Operating Modes (Storage offloading vs PD transport - same connector abstraction)
Persistent KV store across queries and sessions
GPU overflow to CPU - async write to disk/remote
Prefix reuse + non-prefix reuse via CacheBlend
Survives process restart when backed by disk
LRU eviction - prefetch hot chunks back to CPU
Prefill worker computes KV - decode worker generates
Batched contiguous transfer vs page-by-page copy
Maps token sequences to KV chunk locations
Token processor: count new vs matched tokens
Event manager tracks query ID memory addresses
Custom allocator for KV MemoryObj instances
Pinned CPU memory for fast GPU-CPU DMA
Async disk/remote tasks - non-blocking infer thread
L4 - Multi-Tier Storage Hierarchy (GPU active set - CPU hot - local cold - remote durable)
Active paged KV blocks in engine memory manager
Hot cache - pinned memory - lmcache server L1 pool
Large local tier for long documents / cold cache
Async compress + write - prefetch on reuse
Layer-wise async load events during prefill
L5 - LMCache Controller + Advanced Features (first-class cache orchestration API)
lookup - clear - move - pin/unpin - health check
Centralized mgmt for single + distributed workers
Reuse KV blocks at any prompt position
Selective recompute tokens for quality recovery
Publish cache state for cache-aware routing
Monitor + metrics for cache hit ratio / TTFT
MP mode exposes management HTTP endpoints
L6 - Package Layout + Config (lmcache/ - integration/vllm/ - LMCacheEngineBuilder)
Connector integrates with vLLM paged KV manager + scheduler token accounting
Step 1: Request arrives - scheduler calls get_num_new_matched_tokens on connector
Step 2: Token DB lookup - hash chunks (256 tok) - return matched prefix length
Step 3a HIT: Async prefetch CPU/disk KV - layer-wise load to GPU - skip prefill compute
Step 3b MISS: Model computes new KV - connector stores chunks to LocalCPU backend
Step 4: Async offload tasks write to disk/remote - LRU evict - decode continues on GPU
Optional: I/O/compute overlap - requeue request to wait queue during remote fetch
KV cache as reusable AI-native knowledge - not ephemeral GPU-only state
Or: kv_connector LMCacheConnectorV1 kv_role kv_both for in-process single-node experiments
Design Position (vendor-neutral KV cache layer - decouple storage from fast-evolving inference engines)
Tiered offload + modular connector + async batched movement + control API = enterprise-scale KV reuse
Init: kv-transfer-config or lmcache server - connector hooks scheduler + model runner - token DB index
Loop: lookup chunks - hit load / miss compute - async tier offload - decode - events publish - controller mgmt
Sources: github.com/LMCache/LMCache - docs.lmcache.ai - arXiv 2510.09665 - vLLM kv-transfer docs
